description: This file contains functions and types for converting Prometheus MetricFamily protobuf messages into the OpenMetrics text format, including options for including created timestamps and units, and functions for writing individual samples, labels, and finalizing the output.

methods.name: WithCreatedLines
methods.description: Returns an EncoderOption that configures the encoder to include _created timestamp lines.

methods.name: WithUnit
methods.description: Returns an EncoderOption that enables adding units to metric names and output.

methods.name: MetricFamilyToOpenMetrics
methods.description: Converts a protobuf MetricFamily into OpenMetrics text format, writing to the provided writer, with optional configuration.

methods.name: FinalizeOpenMetrics
methods.description: Writes the final '# EOF' line to complete the OpenMetrics output.

methods.name: writeOpenMetricsSample
methods.description: Writes a single metric sample in OpenMetrics format, including labels, value, timestamp, and exemplar.

methods.name: writeOpenMetricsNameAndLabelPairs
methods.description: Formats metric name and label pairs in OpenMetrics style, handling quoting and escaping.

methods.name: writeOpenMetricsCreated
methods.description: Writes a created timestamp line for a metric in OpenMetrics format.

methods.name: writeExemplar
methods.description: Writes an exemplar (sample with labels) in OpenMetrics format.

methods.name: writeOpenMetricsFloat
methods.description: Formats a float64 in OpenMetrics style, appending '.0' when needed.

methods.name: writeUint
methods.description: Writes a uint64 value as string.
